card.name: Start of DEFITELIO and similar names
card.fires_on: The piece "DEF" at the start of the brand name DEFITELIO (also DEFENCATH), usually after Administer or Discontinue. It also fires on "with" in the DRESS abbreviation and on "M" at the start of machine or craft names.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: The first piece of the brand name DEFITELIO or DEFENCATH right after a dosing verb.
modes.example: • Administer<< DEF>>ITELIO by constant intravenous infusion

modes.label: DRESS expansion
modes.description: The word "with" inside the spelled-out DRESS abbreviation.
modes.example: DRESS = Drug Rash<< with>> Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms

modes.label: Machine or craft name
modes.description: The letter M starting a product or vehicle name in general web text.
modes.example: the first test piece produced on the<< M>>2 Cusing Machine at the Marshall Space
